title: urostigma bengalense
intro: Urostigma bengalense, commonly known as the Bengal ironwood, is a plant species native to the Himalayas. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine. The health benefits of Urostigma bengalense include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
